summary: v52g+ follow-up — CSRF 403 persisted for the user because the deeper cause was the csrf_token cookie itself being SameSite=Lax while the platform proxy only rewrites auth cookies to SameSite=None; Partitioned. Cross-site iframes (Emergent preview) drop the Lax CSRF cookie on POST, and require_csrf needs header AND cookie. Fixed at the source: all five auth routers now set csrf_token via security.set_csrf_cookie() with SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned (raw header, Starlette 0.37 has no partitioned kwarg). Earlier sessionStorage cacheCsrf layer kept as fallback.

verification.set_cookie_header: curl login response shows 'Set-Cookie: csrf_token=...; Max-Age=86400; Path=/; Secure; SameSite=None; Partitioned'.
verification.cross_site_iframe_e2e: PASS — localhost page embedding the preview URL in an iframe: login reached /escrow/me, document.cookie inside the iframe contains csrf_token, change request on office_phone submitted with success toast and pending entry; zero CSRF errors. Screenshot /app/test_reports/iteration_72_iframe_csrf.png.
verification.note: Sessions created before this fix must sign out and sign back in once to receive the new cookie.
